known_assets: Map 1 uses the existing Wikimedia Commons wall/floor/stone material sources.
Map 4 uses the existing warm stone re-grade for the world-anchored tunnel.
Map 5 v24 avenue, shoulders, depth field, monumental violet columns and giant hinged signs are procedural world geometry.
Map 5 v24 columns extend from Y=-30 to Y=34/41 with procedural vertical dark-to-light violet shading.
No new external dependency was added in v24.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by current runtime.
rule: Map 5 must read as a broad monumental avenue. Columns are architecture, not props: they continue far below and far above the visible frame.
